40021022.author: पदार्थः
40021022.content: सुमालिनं Sumalin, हतं killed, दृष्ट्वा having seen, वसुना by Vasu, भस्मसात्कृतम् reduced to ashes, स्वसैन्यं his own army, विद्रुतं fled, च and, अपि also, लक्षयित्वा having observed, अर्दितं tormented, सुरैः by the gods.

40021022.author: Translation
40021022.content: Having seen Sumalin killed and reduced to ashes by Vasu, and observing his own army fleeing and tormented by the gods, (Meghanada reacted).

40021023.author: पदार्थः
40021023.content: ततः then, सः he, बलवान् powerful, क्रुद्धः enraged, रावणस्य Ravana's, सुतः son, तदा at that time, निवर्त्य having turned back/stopped, राक्षसान् the rakshasas, सर्वान् all, मेघनादः Meghanada, व्यवस्थितः stood firm/prepared.

40021023.author: Translation
40021023.content: Then, that powerful son of Ravana, Meghanada, enraged, stopped all the fleeing rakshasas and stood firm.

40021024.author: पदार्थः
40021024.content: सुरथेन with a beautiful chariot, अग्निवर्णेन of fiery color, कामगेन moving at will, महारथः the great charioteer (Meghanada), अभिदुद्राव rushed towards, सेनां the army, तां that, वनानि forests, अग्निः fire, इव like, ज्वलन् burning.

40021024.author: Translation
40021024.content: The great charioteer, Meghanada, with his beautiful, fiery-colored chariot that moved at will, rushed towards that army, burning like a fire consuming forests.

40021025.author: पदार्थः
40021025.content: ततः then, प्रविशतः as he entered, तस्य his, विविधायुधधारिणः bearing various weapons, विदुद्रुवुः fled, दिशः directions, सर्वाः all, दर्शनात् from the sight, एव merely, देवताः the gods.

40021025.author: Translation
40021025.content: Then, as he, bearing various weapons, entered the battle, the gods fled in all directions merely at his sight.

40021026.author: पदार्थः
40021026.content: न not, बभूव was, तदा then, कश्चित् anyone, युयुत्सोः wishing to fight, अस्य his, सम्मुखे in front of, सर्वान् all, आविद्ध्य having pierced/wounded, वित्रस्तान् terrified ones, ततः then, शक्रः Indra, अब्रवीत् spoke, सुरान् to the gods.

40021026.author: Translation
40021026.content: Then, no one dared to stand before him, who was eager to fight, and after he had wounded all the terrified gods, Indra spoke to them.

40021027.author: पदार्थः
40021027.content: न not, भेतव्यं to be feared, न not, गन्तव्यं to be gone, निवर्तध्वं retreat, रणे in battle, सुराः O gods, एष this, गच्छति goes, पुत्रो son, मे my, युद्धार्थम् for battle, अपराजितः unconquered.

40021027.author: Translation
40021027.content: Indra instructs the gods not to fear or retreat from battle, as his unconquered son is now advancing to fight.

40021028.author: पदार्थः
40021028.content: ततः then, शक्रसुतो Indra's son, देवो the god, जयन्त Jayanta, इति thus, विश्रुतः renowned, रथेन by chariot, अद्भुतकल्पेन wonderfully made, सङ्ग्रामे in battle, सो he, अभ्यवर्तत advanced.

40021028.author: Translation
40021028.content: Then, the renowned god Jayanta, son of Indra, advanced into battle with his wonderfully designed chariot.

40021029.author: पदार्थः
40021029.content: ततस्ते then they, त्रिदशाः the gods, सर्वे all, परिवार्य surrounding, शचीसुतम् Shachi's son, रावणस्य Ravana's, सुतं son, युद्धे in battle, समासाद्य having approached, प्रजघ्निरे they attacked.

40021029.author: Translation
40021029.content: Then all the gods, surrounding Shachi's son Jayanta, approached Ravana's son in battle and attacked him.

40021030.author: पदार्थः
40021030.content: तेषां their, युद्धं battle, समभवत् occurred, सदृशं similar, देवरक्षसाम् of gods and Rakshasas, महेन्द्रस्य of Mahendra, च and, पुत्रस्य of the son, राक्षसेन्द्रसुतस्य of the son of the lord of Rakshasas, च and.

40021030.author: Translation
40021030.content: A battle then ensued between them, resembling the conflicts of gods and Rakshasas, specifically between Mahendra's son (Jayanta) and the son of the lord of Rakshasas (Meghanada).

40021031.author: पदार्थः
40021031.content: ततो then, मातलिपुत्रे on Matali's son, तु indeed, गोमुखे Gomukha, राक्षसात्मजः the son of the Rakshasa, सारथौ on the charioteer, पातयामास he shot, शरान् arrows, कनकभूषणान् gold-embellished.

40021031.author: Translation
40021031.content: Then, the son of the Rakshasa (Meghanada) shot gold-embellished arrows at Matali's son, Gomukha, who was the charioteer.

40021032.author: पदार्थः
40021032.content: शचीसुतः Shachi's son, च and, अपि also, तथा similarly, जयन्तः Jayanta, तस्य his, सारथिम् charioteer, तम् him, च and, अपि also, रावणिः Ravana's son, क्रुद्धः enraged, समन्तात् from all sides, प्रत्यविध्यत pierced.

40021032.author: Translation
40021032.content: Enraged, Ravana's son Indrajit pierced Jayanta, the son of Shachi, and also Indra's charioteer from all sides.

40021033.author: पदार्थः
40021033.content: सः He, हि indeed, क्रोधसमाविष्टः filled with rage, बली powerful, विस्फारितेक्षणः with wide-open eyes, रावणिः Ravana's son, शक्रतनयम् Indra's son, शरवर्षैः with showers of arrows, अवाकिरत् covered.

40021033.author: Translation
40021033.content: Indeed, that powerful son of Ravana, filled with rage and with wide-open eyes, showered Indra's son Jayanta with a volley of arrows.

40021034.author: पदार्थः
40021034.content: ततः Then, नानाप्रहरणान् various weapons, शितधारान् sharp-edged, सहस्रशः by thousands, पातयामास hurled, सङ्क्रुद्धः greatly enraged, सुरसैन्येषु upon the armies of the gods, रावणिः Ravana's son.

40021034.author: Translation
40021034.content: Then, greatly enraged, Ravana's son hurled thousands of various sharp-edged weapons upon the armies of the gods.

40021035.author: पदार्थः
40021035.content: शतघ्नीम् a weapon killing hundreds, मुसल mace, प्रास spear, गदा club, खड्ग sword, परश्वधान् axes, महान्ति huge, गिरिशृङ्गाणि mountain peaks, पातयामास hurled, रावणिः Ravana's son.

40021035.author: Translation
40021035.content: Ravana's son hurled hundreds of weapons, maces, spears, clubs, swords, axes, and even huge mountain peaks.

40021036.author: पदार्थः
40021036.content: ततः Then, प्रव्यथिताः greatly distressed, लोकाः worlds, सञ्जज्ञे arose, च and, तमः darkness, अभवत् occurred, तस्य his, रावणपुत्रस्य Ravana's son's, शत्रुसैन्यानि enemy armies, निघ्नतः while destroying.

40021036.author: Translation
40021036.content: Then, as Ravana's son destroyed the enemy armies, the worlds became greatly distressed, and darkness enveloped everything.

40021037.author: पदार्थः
40021037.content: ततः then, तत् that, दैवतबलम् divine army, समन्तात् all around, तम् him, शचीसुतम् son of Shachi, बहुप्रकारम् in many ways, अस्वस्थम् distressed, अभवत् became, शरपीडितम् afflicted by arrows.

40021037.author: Translation
40021037.content: Then, that divine army surrounding the son of Shachi became distressed in many ways, being afflicted by arrows.

40021038.author: पदार्थः
40021038.content: न not, अभ्यजानन्त recognized, च and, अन्योन्यम् each other, रक्षः a demon, वा or, देवता a god, अथवा or, तत्र तत्र here and there, विपर्यस्तम् confused, समन्तात् all around, परिधावति ran about.

40021038.author: Translation
40021038.content: They could not recognize each other, whether they were demons or gods, and in their confusion, they ran about everywhere.

40021039.author: पदार्थः
40021039.content: देवाः gods, देवान् gods, निजघ्नुः killed, ते they, राक्षसान् demons, राक्षसाः demons, तथा similarly, सम्मूढाः utterly bewildered, तमसा by darkness, आच्छन्नाः covered, व्यद्रवन् fled, अपरे others, तथा similarly.

40021039.author: Translation
40021039.content: The gods killed other gods, and similarly, the demons killed other demons, while others, utterly bewildered and enveloped in confusion, fled.

40021040.author: पदार्थः
40021040.content: एतस्मिन् in this, अन्तरे interval, वीरः brave, पुलोमा Puloma, नाम named, वीर्यवान् powerful, दैत्येन्द्रः king of Daityas, तेन by him, सङ्गृह्य having seized, शचीपुत्रः son of Shachi, अपवाहितः carried away.

40021040.author: Translation
40021040.content: In this interval, the brave and powerful Daitya king named Puloma seized the son of Shachi and carried him away.

40021041.author: पदार्थः
40021041.content: सङ्गृह्य having seized, तम् him, तु indeed, दौहित्रम् grandson, प्रविष्टः entered, सागरम् ocean, तदा then, आर्यकः maternal grandfather, सः he, हि indeed, तस्य his, आसीत् was, पुलोमा Puloma, येन by whom, सा she, शची Shachi.

40021041.author: Translation
40021041.content: Having seized his grandson, Puloma then entered the ocean, for he was indeed the maternal grandfather of Jayanta, as Shachi was his daughter.

40021042.author: पदार्थः
40021042.content: ज्ञात्वा having known, प्रणाशं defeat, तु indeed, तदा then, जयन्तस्य of Jayanta, अथ then, देवताः the gods, अप्रहृष्टाः unhappy, ततः then, सर्वाः all, व्यथिताः distressed, सम्प्रदुद्रुवुः fled.

40021042.author: Translation
40021042.content: Knowing then of Jayanta's defeat, all the gods became unhappy and distressed, and then they fled.

40021043.author: पदार्थः
40021043.content: रावणिः Ravana's son, तु indeed, अथ then, सङ्क्रुद्धः greatly enraged, बलैः by forces, परिवृतः surrounded, स्वकैः by his own, अभ्यधावत rushed towards, देवांस्तान् those gods, मुमोच uttered, च and, महास्वनम् a great roar.

40021043.author: Translation
40021043.content: Then, Ravana's son, greatly enraged and surrounded by his own forces, rushed towards those gods and uttered a mighty roar.

40021044.author: पदार्थः
40021044.content: दृष्ट्वा having seen, प्रणाशं defeat, पुत्रस्य of the son, दैवतेषु among the gods, च and, विद्रुतम् the flight, मातलिं to Matali, च and, आह said, देवेशः the lord of gods, रथः the chariot, समुपनीयताम् let it be brought forth.

40021044.author: Translation
40021044.content: Having seen the defeat of his son and the flight of the gods, the lord of gods then said to Matali, "Let the chariot be brought forth."

40021045.author: पदार्थः
40021045.content: सः that, तु indeed, दिव्यः divine, महाभीमः very formidable, सज्जः ready, एव indeed, महारथः great chariot, उपस्थितः appeared, मातलिना by Matali, वाह्यमानः being driven, महाजवः of great speed.

40021045.author: Translation
40021045.content: That divine, very formidable, and indeed ready great chariot, of immense speed, was then brought forth by Matali.

40021046.author: पदार्थः
40021046.content: ततः then, मेघाः clouds, रथे in the chariot, तस्मिन् that, तडित्त्वन्तः with lightning, महाबलाः very powerful, अग्रतः in front, वायुचपलाः swift as wind, नेदुः roared, परमनिःस्वनाः with mighty sounds.

40021046.author: Translation
40021046.content: Then, very powerful clouds, bearing lightning and swift as the wind, roared with mighty sounds in front of that chariot.

40021047.author: पदार्थः
40021047.content: नानावाद्यानि various musical instruments, वाद्यन्त were played, गन्धर्वाश्च and Gandharvas, समाहिताः attentive, ननृतुश्चाप्सरःसङ्घा and groups of Apsaras danced, निर्याते when he departed, त्रिदशेश्वरे the lord of the gods.

40021047.author: Translation
40021047.content: As the lord of the gods, Indra, departed, various musical instruments were played, Gandharvas sang attentively, and groups of Apsaras danced.

40021048.author: पदार्थः
40021048.content: रुद्रैः by Rudras, वसुभिः by Vasus, आदित्यैः by Adityas, साध्यैश्च and by Sadhyas, समरुद्गणैः along with the Marut groups, वृतो surrounded, नानाप्रहरणैः with various weapons, निर्ययौ departed, त्रिदशाधिपः the lord of the gods.

40021048.author: Translation
40021048.content: The lord of the gods, surrounded by Rudras, Vasus, Adityas, Sadhyas, and groups of Maruts, all bearing various weapons, then departed.

40021049.author: पदार्थः
40021049.content: निर्गच्छतस्तु but as he was departing, शक्रस्य of Shakra, परुषं harsh, पवनो wind, ववौ blew, भास्करो the sun, निष्प्रभश्चासीत् and became lusterless, महोल्काश्च and great meteors, प्रपेदिरे fell.

40021049.author: Translation
40021049.content: However, as Shakra departed, a harsh wind blew, the sun became dim, and large meteors fell, indicating ill omens.

40021050.author: पदार्थः
40021050.content: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे in the meantime, शूरो the brave, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, प्रतापवान् mighty, आरुरोह ascended, रथं chariot, दिव्यं divine, निर्मितं constructed, विश्वकर्मणा by Vishvakarma.

40021050.author: Translation
40021050.content: At that very moment, the brave and mighty Dashagriva (Ravana) ascended a divine chariot that had been crafted by Vishvakarma.

40021051.author: पदार्थः
40021051.content: पन्नगैः by serpents, सुमहाकार्यैः of very great bodies, वेष्टितं entwined, रोमहर्षणैः terrifying, तेषां their, निःश्वासवातेन by the breath-wind, प्रदीप्तमिव as if blazing, संयुगे in battle.

40021051.author: Translation
40021051.content: This chariot was entwined by terrifying serpents of immense size, whose breath-like wind made it appear as if blazing in battle.

40021052.author: पदार्थः
40021052.content: दैत्यैः by demons, निशाचरैः by night-wanderers, च and, एव indeed, सः that, रथः chariot, परिवारितः surrounded, समराभिमुखः facing the battle, दैत्यः the demon, महेन्द्रम् towards Mahendra, सः he, अभ्यवर्तत advanced.

40021052.author: Translation
40021052.content: Surrounded by demons and night-wanderers, that chariot, with the demon facing the battle, advanced towards Mahendra.

40021053.author: पदार्थः
40021053.content: पुत्रम् son, तम् him, वारयित्वा having restrained, तु but, स्वयम् himself, एव indeed, व्यवस्थितः stood, सः he, अपि also, युद्धात् from the battle, विनिष्क्रम्य having exited, रावणिः Ravani, समुपाविशत् sat down.

40021053.author: Translation
40021053.content: Having restrained his son, he himself took his position, while Ravani, having exited the battle, also sat down.

40021054.author: पदार्थः
40021054.content: ततः then, युद्धम् battle, प्रवृत्तम् commenced, तु indeed, सुराणाम् of the gods, राक्षसैः with the rakshasas, सह together with, शस्त्राणि weapons, वर्षताम् showering, घोरम् terrible, मेघानाम् of clouds, इव like, संयुगे in battle.

40021054.author: Translation
40021054.content: Then, a terrible battle commenced between the gods and the rakshasas, with weapons showering down like clouds in a fight.

40021055.author: पदार्थः
40021055.content: कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, तु but, दुष्टात्मा evil-minded, नानाप्रहरणोद्यतः ready with various weapons, न not, अज्ञायत was known, तदा then, युद्धे in battle, सह with, केन whom, अपि even, अयुध्यत he fought.

40021055.author: Translation
40021055.content: The evil-minded Kumbhakarna, ready with various weapons, was then not known with whom he was fighting in the battle.

40021056.author: पदार्थः
40021056.content: दन्तैः with teeth, भुजाभ्याम् with two arms, पद्मां lotus, च and, शक्तितोमरसायकैः with shaktis, tomaras, and arrows, येन केन by whatever, एव indeed, संरब्धः enraged, ताडयामास he struck, वै indeed, सुरान् the gods.

40021056.author: Translation
40021056.content: Enraged, he indeed struck the gods with teeth, with two arms, a lotus, and with shaktis, tomaras, and arrows, by whatever means possible.

40021057.author: पदार्थः
40021057.content: ततः then, रुद्रैः by the Rudras, महाघोरैः extremely terrible, सङ्गम्य having encountered, अथ and, निशाचरः the night-wanderer (Kumbhakarna), प्रयुद्धः fought, तैः by them, च and, सङ्ग्रामे in battle, क्षतः wounded, शस्त्रैः by weapons, निरन्तरम् continuously.

40021057.author: Translation
40021057.content: Then, the night-wanderer Kumbhakarna, having encountered and fought with the extremely terrible Rudras in battle, was continuously wounded by their weapons.

40021058.author: पदार्थः
40021058.content: बभौ shone, शस्त्राचिततनुः whose body was covered with weapons, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, क्षरन् flowing, असृक् blood, विद्युत्स्तनितनिर्घोषः with the roar of thunder and lightning, धारवानिव like a rain-bearing, तोयदः cloud.

40021058.author: Translation
40021058.content: Kumbhakarna, with his body covered in weapons and oozing blood, appeared like a rain-bearing cloud accompanied by the roar of thunder and lightning.

40021059.author: पदार्थः
40021059.content: ततः then, तत् that, राक्षसं Rakshasa, सैन्यं army, प्रयुद्धं having fought, समरुद्गणैः with the Marut hosts, रणे in battle, विद्रावितं dispersed, सर्वं all, नानाप्रहरणैः by various weapons, शितैः sharp.

40021059.author: Translation
40021059.content: Then, that entire Rakshasa army, having fought with the Marut hosts, was routed in battle by their sharp and various weapons.

40021060.author: पदार्थः
40021060.content: केचित् some, विनिहताः killed, कृत्ताः cut down, च and, चेष्टन्ति स्म were writhing, महीतले on the ground, वाहनेषु on their vehicles, अवसक्ताः clinging, च and, स्थिताः remained, एव indeed, अपरे others, रणे in battle.

40021060.author: Translation
40021060.content: Some were killed and cut down, writhing on the ground, while others remained stuck on their vehicles in the battle.

40021061.author: पदार्थः
40021061.content: रथान् chariots, नागान् elephants, खरान् donkeys, उष्ट्रान् camels, पन्नगान् serpents, तुरगान् horses, रणे in battle, शिंशुमारान् porpoises, वराहांश्च and boars, पिशाचवदनान् and those with demon-like faces, तथा similarly.

40021061.author: Translation
40021061.content: In the battle, there were chariots, elephants, donkeys, camels, serpents, horses, porpoises, boars, and creatures with demon-like faces.

40021062.author: पदार्थः
40021062.content: तान् them, समालिङ्ग्य embracing, बाहुभ्याम् with two arms, विष्टब्धाः obstructed/paralyzed, केचित् some, उच्छ्रुताः raised high, देवैः by the gods, तु but, शस्त्रसम्भिन्नाः pierced by weapons, मम्रिरे died, च and, निशाचराः night-wanderers.

40021062.author: Translation
40021062.content: Some night-wanderers, embracing others with their arms, were paralyzed and raised high, while others, pierced by the weapons of the gods, died.

40021063.author: पदार्थः
40021063.content: चित्रकर्म a painting, इव like, आभाति appears, सः that, तेषाम् of them, रणसम्प्लवः battle-commotion, निहतानाम् of the slain, प्रमत्तानाम् of the heedless, राक्षसानाम् of the Rakshasas, महीतले on the surface of the earth.

40021063.author: Translation
40021063.content: That scene of the slain and heedless Rakshasas on the earth, amidst the battle's chaos, appeared like a painting.

40021064.author: पदार्थः
40021064.content: शोणितोदकनिष्पन्द flowing with blood as water, कङ्कगृध्रसमाकुला crowded with vultures and eagles, प्रवृत्ता flowed forth, संयुगमुखे at the forefront of the battle, शस्त्रग्राहवती having weapons as alligators, नदी a river.

40021064.author: Translation
40021064.content: At the forefront of the battle, a river flowed forth, its waters of blood, crowded with vultures and eagles, and having weapons as its alligators.

40021065.author: पदार्थः
40021065.content: एतस्मिन् in this, अन्तरे interval, क्रुद्धः enraged, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, प्रतापवान् mighty, निरीक्ष्य having seen, तत् that, बलम् army, कृत्स्नम् entire, दैवतैः by the gods, विनिपातितम् destroyed.

40021065.author: Translation
40021065.content: In the meantime, the mighty Dashagriva, enraged upon seeing his entire army destroyed by the gods, reacted fiercely.

40021066.author: पदार्थः
40021066.content: सः he, तम् that, प्रति towards, विगाह्य having plunged into, आशु quickly, प्रवृद्धम् swollen, सैन्यसागरम् ocean of army, त्रिदशान् the gods, समरे in battle, निघ्नन् striking, शक्रम् Indra, एव indeed, अभ्यवर्तत attacked.

40021066.author: Translation
40021066.content: He quickly plunged into that swollen ocean of the enemy army, striking down the gods in battle, and advanced directly towards Indra.

40021067.author: पदार्थः
40021067.content: आगात् came, शक्रः Indra, महत् great, चापम् bow, विस्फार्य having stretched, सुमहास्वनम् with a very great sound, यस्य whose, विस्फारघोषेण by the sound of stretching (the bow), स्तनन्ति स्म were thundering, दिशः directions, दश ten

40021067.author: Translation
40021067.content: Indra arrived, drawing his mighty bow with a tremendous sound, the reverberations of which caused the ten directions to thunder.

40021068.author: पदार्थः
40021068.content: तत् that, विकृष्य having drawn, महत् great, चापम् bow, इन्द्रः Indra, रावणमूर्धनि on Ravana's head, निपातयामास rained down, शरान् arrows, पावकादित्यवर्चसः having the brilliance of fire and the sun

40021068.author: Translation
40021068.content: Drawing that great bow, Indra rained down arrows on Ravana's head, arrows that shone with the brilliance of fire and the sun.

40021069.author: पदार्थः
40021069.content: तथैव just so, च and, महाबाहुः the mighty-armed, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva (Ravana), व्यवस्थितः stood firm, शक्रम् Indra, कार्मुकविभ्रष्टैः released from his bow, शरवर्षैः with showers of arrows, अवाकिरत् covered

40021069.author: Translation
40021069.content: And similarly, the mighty-armed Dashagriva stood firm and covered Indra with showers of arrows released from his bow.

40021070.author: पदार्थः
40021070.content: प्रयुध्यतोः as they fought, अथ then, तयोः of those two, बाणवर्षैः with showers of arrows, समन्ततः all around, न not, ज्ञायते was known, तदा then, किञ्चित् anything, सर्वम् everything, हि indeed, तमसा by darkness, वृतम् covered

40021070.author: Translation
40021070.content: As those two fought with showers of arrows all around, nothing could be discerned then, for everything was indeed covered by darkness. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे ऽष्टाविंशः सर्गः ।। 28 ।। Thus ends the twenty-eighth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
